samples.source:
Draw in the raging fires and envelop yourself in them. Remove all burns from enemies in a radius of 5 around you, and create a shield lasting %d turns with a power of %d, increased by 15%% for each burn removed.
		When the shield ends, it releases a burst of fire in a radius of %d around you, burning all enemies for 3 turns, doing damage equal to the initial power of the shield.
samples.target:
吸取燃烧中的烈焰，将自己包裹其中。
		除去半径 5 内的敌方生物身上的燃烧效果，同时制造一层持续 %d 轮的 %d 强度的护盾，每吸收一层燃烧效果护盾强度增加 15%%。
		当护盾效果结束时，将在半径 %d 范围内释放一次火焰爆炸，灼烧周围生物 3 回合，造成等于护盾初始值的伤害。

samples.source: The target is surrounded by a magical shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles and dealing %d damage in a radius of %d when it does.
samples.target: 目标被一层魔法护盾包围，吸收 %d/%d 伤害，护盾结束时（无论吸收耗尽还是自然到期），引燃持续 3 回合、总计造成 %d 伤害且范围为半径 %d 的灼烧。

prior_review_origin.finding: Fiery Aegis talent info translates burning all enemies as 灼烧周围生物, losing the enemy-only recipient relation.
prior_review_origin.disposition: confirmed pre-existing advisory queued for this separate bounded batch

claims: The burn-removal projection uses explicit radius 10 and no directly relevant helper rewrites it.
friendlyfire=false prevents self, allied and neutral actors from reaching the burn-removal callback under the fixed engine filter; hostile actors can reach it.
The shield-end FIREBURN projection uses friendlyfire=false and eff.radius, matching the enemy-only English and burst-radius placeholder.
The hard-coded English radius 5 conflicts with the observed unpinned Ashes action radius 10.
The info has three format arguments; changing literal 5 to 10 does not affect placeholders or 15%% escaping.
source_resolution.routing_note: A later user decision makes Gemini 3.7 Flash high the default for future straightforward source scouts; this completed read-only dispatch is retained and not repeated.

facts: action creates a range-0 ball with radius 10 and friendlyfire=false, then removes fire detrimental effects from actors reaching its callback.
info hard-codes radius 5 and says burning all enemies; its three arguments are shield duration, shield power and burst radius.
deactivate projects FIREBURN with radius=eff.radius, friendlyfire=false, dur=3 and dam=spellCrit(eff.power).
The projection excludes reaction-nonnegative actors when friendlyfire is false and calls the function/damage projector only in the remaining branch.
An explicit target radius is copied to typ.ball and not rewritten by default filling.
